item.title: Manistique Area Schools: fire alarm set off by blown fuse
item.description: The alarm sounded around 8:00 a.m. Students returned safely to the building at 8:07 a.m.

item.title: Hall outlines $800M spending cuts, property tax overhaul; rejects new taxes in budget talks
item.description: Michigan House Speaker Matt Hall says Republicans will cut $800 million from the state budget rather than approve new taxes to address projected shortfalls. He also unveiled a sweeping property tax reform proposal he says would save homeowners hundreds of dollars annually.

item.title: Consumer Advocates Praise Supreme Court Ruling on Trump’s Global Tariffs, President Criticizes Court
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - In a six to three decision, the Supreme Court struck down the President’s global tariffs. In response to the ruling, the President said he will sign an order imposing a ten percent global tariff.

item.title: Escanaba City Council approves resolution allowing golf carts on certain roadways
item.description: Golf carts cannot drive above 15 miles per hour, and high-traffic areas like Ludington Street and Lincoln road are off limits.

item.title: MDHHS recognizes two years of safe storage gun law
item.description: Since Public Act 17 was signed in February 2024, approximately 110,600 gun locks have been distributed across Michigan, with over 63,000 through 2025.

item.description: Chris Mapps held a Conversations and Coffee event at Provisions Friday afternoon to further discuss his goals for the region.

item.title: Insights: Chris Hansen gives more details on Dickinson Co. child exploitation sting operation
item.description: In October of 2025, the Dickinson County Sheriff's Office conducted a child exploitation sting operation in Iron Mountain. It led to the arrests of seven men who thought they would be meeting with a minor. Instead, they were met with law enforcement and Chris Hansen. Streaming platform TruBlu has released the first episode of Takedown with Chris Hansen involving that operation.
